items.title: RSG Q3 deep dive: pricing discipline and Environmental Solutions momentum shape outlook
items.summary: Waste management company Republic Services (NYSE:RSG) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 8.2% year on year to $4.56 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $17.45 billion at the midpoint came in 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.94 per share was 0.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Republic Services (RSG) Stock Extends Q3 Earnings Momentum On Cash Flow Strength
items.summary: Republic Services stock jumped 3.3% to about US$244 in the first full session after reporting Q3 2026 results, extending an already strong 30 day run. The market liked what it saw. The real story sits in the cash generation behind that move. Adjusted earnings per share reached about US$1.94, while trailing 12 month earnings are tracked at just over US$7 per share, supporting a P/E near 34x.
